data.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

levels.name: Search Input Glow
levels.description: Golden/amber glow effect with 18% opacity for search input focus states. Creates a warm, branded elevation effect.

levels.name: Tooltip Shadow
levels.description: Subtle shadow for tooltips and popovers with 12% black opacity and 4px Y-offset, 6px blur. Provides gentle lift for informational overlays.

levels.name: Overlay Container Shadow
levels.description: Dual-layer shadow for overlay containers: 19% opacity at 2px Y-offset with 6px blur, plus 19% opacity ambient shadow at 2px blur. Creates medium elevation for modal-like containers.

levels.name: GFN Promo Card Shadow - Mobile
levels.description: Card shadow for promotional content with 12% black opacity, 4px blur. Used for mobile viewport game promo cards.

levels.name: GFN Promo Card Shadow - Desktop
levels.description: Lighter card shadow for desktop/tablet viewports with 12% black opacity, 2px Y-offset, 4px blur.
when_to_use: GFN game promotional cards on desktop
Featured content cards on larger screens
